items.author: blankuitaco.bsky.social
items.context: Dragons Dogma 2 x Dungeon Meshi...???? ugh... maybe that game is worth it after all
items.text: A crossover like that is a good excuse to give it another look. If you decide to wait for a sale, check the price history first so you know what a real low looks like.

items.author: kimmithy.com
items.context: Is... my standards unrealistic? For what... I get value per dollar...? Avg game cost per hr per game: $1.70–$2.50 ----- Me: 17 Games / 9 yrs 5,881.8 hrs Avg hrs per game: 346 $175 per yr $1,754 spent Avg game cost: $103.18 Cost per hr: $0.30 Cost per hr per game: $0.02 #steam #gaming #PC #gamer
items.text: Those numbers look pretty great to me. $0.30 an hour is hard to beat, and long games are where the value really shows.

items.author: ratbatserd.bsky.social
items.context: my thought process is basically "oh new bethesda game? oh it's new? so no active passionate modding community has had a chance to make it worth while? cool, ill come back in a few years i guess"
items.text: Waiting for the mod scene is a fair call. Big open games usually get a lot better a year or two in, once patches and community fixes pile up.
